title: African Speech ID
subtitle: 1,386 African languages
description: Identify which African language is being spoken in an audio clip. Uses a fast version of Omnilingual ASR to transcribe speech, then a lightweight classifier names the language. Runs entirely on CPU.

title: African Speech Gender ID
subtitle: Audio Classification
description: Identify speaker gender from African speech audio. Trained on diverse African language data for robust performance across accents and recording conditions.
